query:
SELECT COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT $2 IN (SELECT json_array_elements_text(m.spec -> 'data_planes'))
                FROM storage_mappings m
                WHERE m.catalog_prefix = ANY ($1::text[])
                ORDER BY length(m.catalog_prefix) DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            false
        ) AS "admissible!: bool"
